name: fast_charge
description: Fast 2C CC-CV charge to bring the cell back to full
comment: Select the cell at launch. CC-CV charge at up to 2C to the selected cell's max_v, finishing when current tapers to 0.05C. The current is capped to the cell's max_charge_a and the EBC's 5 A ceiling. The 12h limit is a safety ceiling. Follow with slow_finish_charge if a fuller, gentler top-off is needed.
